description: Li hollow->hollow migration barriers in the h-BN@VGCF system: surface diffusion on each sheet vs in-gallery diffusion. Companion to vgcf_hbn_binding_matrix.json (same slabs, same DFT setup).
method: QE 7.4.1-GPU neb.x (esp-Z590). 7 images, CI_scheme='auto', path_thr=0.05 eV/A, nstep_path=150. Hop = one hollow-lattice vector +a1 = 2.46 A along x. Endpoints pre-relaxed (endpoint-B = Li +2.46 A, substrate dimple re-formed) and held fixed by neb.x. PBE-D3BJ PAW 60/480 Ry, 4x4 supercell, k 3x3x1 — identical to the binding matrix.

results.note: Barrier is below our numerical resolution: the whole path spans 7 meV while the per-image force errors reach 46 meV/A (path_thr 0.05). Report as '< 0.01 eV, effectively barrierless', NOT as agreement with Shi2017 (0.10 eV) — we are 13x lower. Internally consistent with our own weak binding (E_bind -0.264 eV) and the large adsorption height (Li sits 2.79 A above the topmost B/N).
Clean symmetric single saddle at xi=0.50. Matches the literature baseline (~0.3 eV) — this is the case that validates the NEB protocol.

results.system: Li intercalated in the h-BN|Li|graphene gallery, 1L each side
results.note: Sharp single saddle at xi=0.51. NOT quoted for the paper — see layer_sensitivity below.

results.system: Li intercalated in the h-BN|Li|graphene gallery, 2L each side
results.note: Broad flat-topped saddle: two maxima (0.1439 eV at xi=0.34, 0.1473 eV at xi=0.64) separated by a 16 meV dip at xi=0.49 — the dip is below kT(300 K)=25.7 meV, so it is a plateau, not a trapping site. Quoted as the representative gallery barrier, matching vgcf_hbn_binding_matrix.json representative_for_paper = gallery_2L2L.

results.system: Li adatom on graphene BILAYER (surface control for the mechanism test)
results.note: The control that decides confinement vs substrate. Same physical change as the gallery VGCF-wall thickening (graphene 1L -> 2L) but with Li on a FREE surface: +11.9 meV, i.e. nothing. Compare -207.2 meV for the same change inside the gallery.

layer_sensitivity.falsifies: The barrier is 4x MORE layer-sensitive than E_bind. This falsifies (a) the 'layer effects cancel because a barrier is a site-energy difference on the same host' assumption in tools/vgcf_hbn/neb_build_kgy.py, and (b) the '1L 모델로 NEB 정당' clause in vgcf_hbn_binding_matrix.json headline.
layer_sensitivity.conclusion_flips: 1L1L puts the gallery ABOVE graphene-surface diffusion (357 > 273 meV, gallery = slow channel); 2L2L puts it BELOW (147 < 273 meV, gallery = fast channel). The qualitative claim of the paper depends on layer count, so the layer trend must be shown, not assumed.
layer_sensitivity.status: RESOLVED (2026-07-30) — 2×2 행렬로 VGCF 지배(98.9%)를, 표면 대조군으로 confinement 기전을 확정. 3L 포화 여부는 여전히 미측정이므로 0.147 eV 는 **하한이 아니라 2L 값**으로만 인용한다.

geometry_diagnostic.note: From the endpoint-A relaxed geometries (Begin final coordinates). z in A; 'dimple' = max(z)-min(z) within one sheet; layers clustered at 0.8 A.

gallery_width_ruled_out.verdict: The gallery geometry is identical to within 0.015 A. The -209 meV barrier shift is NOT a gallery-width effect.

sheet_dimple_A.verdict: The carbon side stiffens as expected when a second layer is added (0.109 -> 0.051, halved), but the BN side does the opposite (0.272 -> 0.373). A pure 'free 1L sheet over-corrugates' story therefore explains only half the effect.

geometry_diagnostic.flag_hbn_corrugation: h-BN sheets show 0.27-0.37 A out-of-plane spread in EVERY cell, vs 0.02-0.11 A for graphene. A relaxed free-standing h-BN monolayer should be planar to <0.01 A. Unresolved: real Li-induced pucker, a ripple of the 4x4 cell, or incomplete relaxation. Check before the h-BN numbers are used quantitatively.

recommended_next: Run the two mixed-layer gallery NEBs (2L|1L and 1L|2L, ~97 atoms each). Their slabs and binding energies already exist in the 2x2 binding matrix (gallery_2L1L -1.580, gallery_1L2L -1.592 eV), so this produces a 2x2 BARRIER matrix that mirrors the existing 2x2 binding matrix: it decomposes which side drives the -209 meV (C stiffening vs BN registry) and shows whether the trend saturates at 2L. That converts the main reviewer objection into a figure panel.

layer_effect_2x2_matrix_COMPLETE_2026_07._what: 209 meV 층수효과를 VGCF 쪽 몫 / h-BN 쪽 몫으로 분해. 네 칸 모두 CI-NEB 수렴 완료.
layer_effect_2x2_matrix_COMPLETE_2026_07.verdict: **209 meV 는 거의 전부 VGCF(graphene) 쪽이다.** VGCF 만 2층으로 하면 -207.2 meV = 전체(-209.4)의 98.9%. h-BN 만 2층으로 하면 +23.5 meV 로 **오히려 약간 나빠진다**.
layer_effect_2x2_matrix_COMPLETE_2026_07._non_additivity_reading: 개별 합 -183.7 vs 실제 전체 -209.4 → 잔차 -25.7 meV. 두 벽 효과가 완전히 독립은 아니지만, 잔차가 VGCF 단독 몫(-207)의 12% 라 'VGCF 지배' 결론은 잔차에 흔들리지 않는다.
layer_effect_2x2_matrix_COMPLETE_2026_07._mechanism_resolved: 2026-07-30: Li_on_graphene_2L 로 판정 완료 → confinement. mechanism_verdict_2026_07_30 참조.
layer_effect_2x2_matrix_COMPLETE_2026_07._saturation_argument: 3L 은 미측정이지만 포화 신호는 있다: 지배하는 VGCF 벽을 2층으로 한 뒤 h-BN 벽까지 2층으로 더해도 0.1495 → 0.1473 eV, 즉 **2 meV** 밖에 안 움직인다(NEB 허용오차 ~20 meV 안). ⚠ 이건 **논거지 측정이 아니다** — 원고에서 그렇게 한정해 쓸 것. 0.147 eV 는 여전히 '수렴값'이 아니라 **2L 값**이다.

mechanism_verdict_2026_07_30._question: 209 meV 가 (a) 그래핀을 두껍게 한 것 자체의 substrate 효과인지, (b) 갤러리에 가둔 상태에서만 나오는 confinement 효과인지.
mechanism_verdict_2026_07_30._design: 같은 변화(그래핀 1L→2L)를 **두 배치**에 각각 가한다. 표면(Li 한쪽만 접촉) vs 갤러리(Li 양쪽 벽 사이). 두 배치의 반응이 같으면 substrate, 다르면 confinement.
mechanism_verdict_2026_07_30.verdict: **CONFINEMENT.** 자유 표면에서 그래핀을 2층으로 만들면 장벽이 +11.9 meV 움직인다 — 우리 NEB 수렴 허용오차 안이라 **사실상 0**이다. 같은 변화를 갤러리 안에서 하면 -207.2 meV. 즉 두 번째 층은 **Li 가 두 벽 사이에 갇혀 있을 때만** 작동한다.
mechanism_verdict_2026_07_30.⚠_resolution_caveat: +11.9 meV 를 '살짝 나빠졌다'로 읽으면 안 된다. path_thr=0.05 eV/Å 에 이미지 간격 ~0.41 Å 이면 에너지 불확도가 ~20 meV 수준이라 **11.9 meV 는 0 과 구별되지 않는다.** 결론은 '표면 효과 없음'이지 '표면에서 약간 악화'가 아니다.
mechanism_verdict_2026_07_30.paper_sentence: The bilayer wall lowers the migration barrier only under confinement: the same graphene 1L->2L change shifts the barrier by -207 meV inside the gallery but by +12 meV (within our NEB tolerance of ~20 meV, i.e. null) for Li on a free graphene surface.
mechanism_verdict_2026_07_30._scope: 따라서 이건 일반화 가능한 'bilayer substrate 를 쓰면 좋다' 원리가 **아니라**, VGCF 다발처럼 **Li 가 갇히는 갤러리 구조**에 특화된 설계 원리다. 논문에서 그렇게 한정해서 써야 한다.
